name: widened-profile-edit
invariant: Authority classifies a profile edit by its effective change, never by the action's name: a narrowing edit is allowed, while one that widens data (explicitly or disguised as dropping the usage override), widens destinations (adding one or emptying the list) removes a protected document, or bundles a widening with a topology change is proposed for a presence-verified human, so a review GO for it is refused (04 "Action registry and effective-change classification").
